query: Somewhere to Grow The seed has outgrown your pocket. It needs a bed. Tobias offers the corner of his own in the greenhouse. Old Maud, passing, says there's a corner in her garden that never gets frost, "if you can keep a secret, dearie." Plant it with Tobias You plant it together by lantern light, and Tobias tells it a long story about a goat to help it settle. It settles. So does Tobias, eventually. Plant it in Maud's garden Maud leads you through a door you'd never noticed into a garden you'll never find on your own. You plant it there. "It'll be happy," she says, "for a while."
